description: This file defines a Java interface 'Revision' which serves as a base type for revision objects, providing comparison and increment methods. It is part of a versioning system within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: Revision
classes.description: A generic interface representing a revision with comparison and increment capabilities. It extends 'Comparable' and defines methods for comparison (greater/less than) and conversion to long or string.

methods.name: isGreaterThan
methods.description: Determines if this revision is greater than the specified revision.

methods.name: isGreaterThanOrEqualTo
methods.description: Checks if this revision is greater than or equal to the specified revision.

methods.name: isLowerThan
methods.description: Determines if this revision is lower than the specified revision.

methods.name: isLowerThanOrEqualTo
methods.description: Checks if this revision is lower than or equal to the specified revision.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Creates a new revision instance by incrementing this revision by one.

methods.name: toLong
methods.description: Returns the revision as a long value.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the revision.
